title: finding-verification.v1
description: S055 §5.2 — output of ONE cold-context verifier agent PER cited finding in ratify-design. Deterministic-first: `grep -n -F "<quote>"` at the cited path — quote absent verbatim => FALSE-POSITIVE `citation-not-found` (MANDATORY, no interpretation rescues it). A VERIFIED verdict WITHOUT a non-empty `cited_text_verbatim` + grep line is SCHEMA-INVALID (enforced by the conditional below). Owner: forge.

cited_text_verbatim.description: The exact bytes found at the cited path (REQUIRED non-empty when verdict==VERIFIED).

grep_line.description: The 1-based line number grep -n -F matched (REQUIRED non-null when verdict==VERIFIED).

allOf.$comment: VERIFIED requires non-empty cited_text_verbatim AND a grep_line (schema-invalid otherwise).
